title: Electromotive force calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates E = Bdv with proper unit conversion of dimensions.

title: Internal resistance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates r = ρ * (d / (a*b)) with proper unit conversion.

title: Circuit current determination
description: Important: Applies Ohm's law for a complete circuit: I = E / (R + r).

title: Output power calculation
description: Important: Calculates output power as P_out = I² * R.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: Converts all given lengths from cm to m before calculations.

title: Motional EMF formula application
description: Optional: Recognizes the generator as a motional EMF problem with E = B * (perpendicular length) * v.

title: Incorrect length for EMF
description: Pitfall: Uses channel length 'a' or width 'b' instead of height 'd' in E = Bdv.

title: Resistance geometry error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect formula for internal resistance (e.g., ρ * a/(bd) or ρ * L/A with wrong area).

title: Sign or unit omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include units in final answers or makes sign errors in circuit analysis.
